titleByLocale.fr: Responsable Senior des Comptes Stratégiques EMEA

jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

Together, we can beat cancer.

At Varian, a Siemens Healthineers Company, we bring together the world's best talent to realize our vision of a world without fear of cancer. Together, we work passionately to develop and deliver easy-to-use, efficient oncology solutions.
We are part of an incredible community of scientists, clinicians, developers, researchers, professionals, and skilled specialists pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, to improve people’s lives around the world. We embrace a culture of inclusivity in which the power and potential of every individual can be unleashed. We spark ideas that lead to positive impact and continued success.

If you want to be part of this important mission, we want to hear from you.

Apply for the Senior Strategic Accounts Manager EMEA position.

Your missions:

• Establishes, fosters and manages relationships with strategically important customers, such as large network providers and key opinion leaders.

• Coordinates internal resources and nurtures a collaborative environment to ensure delivering on customers’ needs and expectations. This includes all cross-functional teams .

• Coordinates the involvement of Varian ’s executive team with customer’s management team on a regular basis and/or as required .

• Creates and leads a company-strategic account plan, including mutual performance objectives , maintains accurate financial forecasts and delivers assigned sales targets.

• Maintains overall deal ownership and is responsible for deal modeling, design & progression

• Represents the entire portfolio of products and services. Leads a cross-company solution development effort that best address customer needs, liaising between key customer personnel and Varian staff.

• Regularly presents all Varian’s solutions to strategic accounts. Maintains knowledge of all products and services.

• Elevates relationships with customers to an advisory/partnership status by enabling their success: clinical excellence, optimized operations and industry leadership.

• Aligns and communicates regularly with local, regional and global teams to ensure a team management approach and a smooth coordination at the account level

• Maintains high customer net promotor scores, by ensuring problem resolution and supporting customer’s strategic ambitions

• Through fostering a mutually beneficial relationship, increases share of wallet and delivers on higher-than-market sales growth and profitability.

• Provides feedback to the marketing and product teams, as a voice of the KOLs, by virtue of constant analysis, assessment and validation of customer needs.

• Participates in the Region financial planning , contributing with Region -wide knowledge of the market, new business and financial models and competitive trends.

• Participates in the development of Region sales incentive plans , in order to meet Region -wide goals by seeking cross-functional alignment of objectives .

• Provide exemplary leadership through proactive communication, effective change management and strategy alignment within the organization

• Build productive internal/external working relationships.

• Investigates industry best practices on strategic account management models, including those already existing in Varian and Siemens Healthineers. As a result, contributes to the design, planning and implementation of the going-forward operating model for EMEA.

Requirements:

• Technical or business degree (management, engineering, etc ).

• Customer facing experience required , especially in Sales or Marketing roles.

• Prior experience in managing complex commerc

descriptionByLocale.it:
Designazione delle merci

Unisciti a noi in scoperte pionieristiche nell'assistenza sanitaria. Per tutti. Ovunque. Sostenibile.

Il nostro ambiente stimolante e premuroso forma una comunità globale che celebra la diversità e l'individualità. Vi incoraggiamo a superare la vostra zona di comfort, offrendo risorse e flessibilità per favorire la vostra crescita professionale e personale, il tutto valorizzando i vostri contributi unici.

Insieme possiamo battere il cancro.

In Varian, una società Siemens Healthineers, raccogliamo il miglior talento del mondo per realizzare la nostra visione di un mondo senza paura del cancro. Insieme, lavoriamo appassionatamente per sviluppare e fornire soluzioni oncologiche facili da usare ed efficienti. Siamo parte di una comunità incredibile di scienziati, medici, sviluppatori, ricercatori, professionisti e specialisti qualificati che si spinge i confini di ciò che è possibile, per migliorare la vita delle persone in tutto il mondo. Abbiamo una cultura di lusinghe in cui si può liberare il potere e il potenziale di ogni individuo.

Scateneremo idee che portano ad un impatto positivo e a un successo continuo.

Se volete far parte di questa importante missione, vogliamo sentirvi.

Domanda per la posizione Senior Strategic Accounts Manager EMEA.

Responsabilità

- Stabilisce, promuove e gestisce relazioni con clienti di importanza strategica, come grandi fornitori di rete e leader di opinione chiave. - Coordina le risorse interne e alimenta un ambiente collaborativo per garantire la fornitura sui clienti. esigenze e aspettative. Ciò include tutti i team interfunzionali. - Coordina il coinvolgimento del team esecutivo Varian con il team di gestione customer.s su base regolare e/o secondo necessità.

- Crea e conduce un piano di account strategico aziendale, inclusi gli obiettivi di performance reciproci, mantiene previsioni finanziarie accurate e fornisce obiettivi di vendita assegnati. - Mantiene la proprietà globale dell'affare ed è responsabile della modellazione, progettazione e progressione dell'affare - Rappresenta l'intero portafoglio di prodotti e servizi. Guida uno sforzo di sviluppo di soluzioni interaziendali che meglio rispondono alle esigenze dei clienti, liaising tra il personale chiave del cliente e il personale Varian. - Presenta regolarmente tutte le soluzioni Varian.

- Solleva i rapporti con i clienti allo status di consulenza/partnership consentendo il loro successo: eccellenza clinica, operazioni ottimizzate e leadership del settore. - Allinea e comunica regolarmente con i team locali, regionali e globali per garantire un approccio di gestione del team e un coordinamento regolare a livello di account - Mantiene alti punteggi promotori netti dei clienti, garantendo la risoluzione dei problemi e supportando le ambizioni strategiche dei clienti - Attraverso la promozione di un rapporto reciprocamente vantaggioso, aumenta la quota di portafoglio e offre una crescita delle vendite superiore al mercato e redditività.

- Fornisce feedback ai team di marketing e prodotti, come voce dei KOL, in virtù di analisi, valutazione e convalida costanti delle esigenze dei clienti. - Partecipa alla pianificazione finanziaria della Regione, contribuendo con la conoscenza a livello regionale del mercato, nuovi modelli commerciali e finanziari e tendenze competitive. - Partecipa allo sviluppo dei piani di incentivazione delle vendite della Regione, al fine di raggiungere obiettivi a livello regionale cercando un allineamento interfunzionale degli obiettivi.

- Fornire una leadership esemplare attraverso una comunicazione proattiva, una gestione efficace dei cambiamenti e un allineamento strategico all'interno dell'organizzazione - Costruire relazioni di lavoro produttive interne/esterni. - Investiga le best practice del settore sui modelli strategici di gestione degli account, compresi quelli già esistenti in Varian e Siemens Healthineers. Di conseguenza, contribuisce alla progettazione, pianificazione e attuazione del modello operativo in corso per l'EMEA.

Requisiti

- Laurea in ingegneria, gestione, ecc. - Esperienza richiesta per il cliente, soprattutto in ambito commerciale o commerciale. - Esperienza precedente nella gestione di un complesso commercio

descriptionByLocale.de:
Warenbezeichnung

Begleiten Sie uns in bahnbrechenden Durchbrüchen im Gesundheitswesen. Für alle. Überall. Nachhaltig.

Unser inspirierendes und fürsorgliches Umfeld bildet eine globale Gemeinschaft, die Vielfalt und Individualität feiert. Wir ermutigen Sie, über Ihre Komfortzone hinauszugehen und Ressourcen und Flexibilität zu bieten, um Ihr professionelles und persönliches Wachstum zu fördern, und das alles mit Ihrer einzigartigen Leistung.

Gemeinsam können wir Krebs besiegen.

Bei Varian, einer Siemens Healthineers Company, bringen wir die besten Talente der Welt zusammen, um unsere Vision von einer Welt ohne Angst vor Krebs zu verwirklichen. Gemeinsam arbeiten wir leidenschaftlich daran, einfach zu entwickeln und zu liefern, um einfache, effiziente Onkologie-Lösungen. Wir sind Teil einer unglaublichen Gemeinschaft von Wissenschaftlern, Klinikern, Entwicklern, Forschern, Fachleuten und qualifizierten Spezialisten, die die Grenzen dessen, was möglich ist, um Menschen zu verbessern, Leben auf der ganzen Welt. Wir umfassen eine Kultur der Inclusivity, in der die Macht und das Potenzial jedes Einzelnen freigesetzt werden kann.

Wir zünden Ideen an, die zu positiven Auswirkungen und anhaltendem Erfolg führen.

Wenn Sie Teil dieser wichtigen Mission sein wollen, wollen wir von Ihnen hören.

Bewerben Sie sich für die Position des Senior Strategic Accounts Manager EMEA.

Zuständigkeiten

- Aufbau, Pflege und Verwaltung von Beziehungen zu strategisch wichtigen Kunden, wie großen Netzwerkanbietern und wichtigen Meinungsführern. - koordiniert interne Ressourcen und fördert ein kollaboratives Umfeld, um die Bereitstellung auf Kunden, Bedürfnisse und Erwartungen zu gewährleisten. Dies umfasst alle funktionsübergreifenden Teams. - koordiniert die Einbeziehung von Varian,s Führungskräfteteam mit Kunden, s Management-Team auf einer regelmäßigen Basis und / oder bei Bedarf.

- Erstellt und leitet einen unternehmensstrategischen Kontoplan, einschließlich gegenseitiger Leistungsziele, hält genaue Finanzprognosen und liefert zugewiesene Umsatzziele. - Bewahrt die Gesamt-Deal-Eigenschaft und ist verantwortlich für Deal-Modellierung, Design & Progression - Vertreten das gesamte Portfolio an Produkten und Dienstleistungen. Führt eine unternehmensübergreifende Lösungsentwicklungsbemühung, die die Bedürfnisse der Kunden am besten anspricht, Verbindung zwischen Schlüsselkundenpersonal und Mitarbeiter von Varian. - Regelmäßig präsentiert alle Varian,s Lösungen strategische Konten. Bewahrt Kenntnisse aller Produkte und Dienstleistungen.

- Erhöht die Beziehungen zu Kunden zu einem Beratungs-/Partnerschaftsstatus, indem sie ihren Erfolg ermöglicht: klinische Exzellenz, optimierte Operationen und Branchenführerschaft. - Richtet und kommuniziert regelmäßig mit lokalen, regionalen und globalen Teams, um einen Teammanagement-Ansatz und eine reibungslose Abstimmung auf Kontoebene sicherzustellen - Bewahrt hohe Kunden-Net-Promotor-Scores, indem es Problemlösung und Kundenunterstützung sicherstellt, strategische Ambitionen - Durch die Förderung einer wechselseitig vorteilhaften Beziehung, erhöht der Anteil der Geldbörse und liefert auf höherem als Markt Umsatzwachstum und Rentabilität.

- Gibt Feedback an die Marketing- und Produktteams, als Stimme der KOLs, durch ständige Analyse, Bewertung und Validierung der Kundenbedürfnisse. - Teilnahme an der Region Finanzplanung, mit Region beitragen -weite Kenntnis des Marktes, neue Geschäfts-und Finanzmodelle und Wettbewerbstrends. - Teilnahme an der Entwicklung der Region Umsatz Anreizpläne, um Region -weite Ziele durch die Suche nach Cross-funktionale Ausrichtung der Ziele zu erfüllen.

- Führen Sie vorbildlich durch proaktive Kommunikation, effektives Change Management und Strategieausrichtung innerhalb der Organisation - Errichten Sie produktive interne/externe Arbeitsbeziehungen. - Untersucht branchenbewährte Verfahren für strategische Account Management-Modelle, einschließlich derjenigen, die bereits in Varian und Siemens Healthineers vorhanden sind. Als Ergebnis trägt zur Gestaltung, Planung und Umsetzung des Zukunftsbetriebsmodells für EMEA bei.

Anforderungen

- Technischer oder kaufmännischer Abschluss (Management, Engineering, etc.). - Kunden mit Erfahrung, die erforderlich ist, insbesondere in Vertriebs- oder Marketingrollen. - Vorherige Erfahrung in der Verwaltung komplexer Kommerz-Geschäfte.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Désignation des marchandises

Rejoignez-nous dans des percées pionnières dans les soins de santé. Pour tout le monde. Partout.

Notre environnement inspirant et bienveillant forme une communauté mondiale qui célèbre la diversité et l'individualité. Nous vous encourageons à dépasser votre zone de confort, en offrant des ressources et de la flexibilité pour favoriser votre croissance professionnelle et personnelle, tout en revalorisant vos contributions uniques.

Ensemble, nous pouvons vaincre le cancer.

Chez Varian, une société Siemens Healthineers, nous réunissons les meilleurs talents du monde pour réaliser notre vision d'un monde sans crainte du cancer. Ensemble, nous travaillons passionnément pour développer et fournir des solutions d'oncologie faciles à utiliser et efficaces. Nous faisons partie d'une incroyable communauté de scientifiques, cliniciens, développeurs, chercheurs, professionnels et spécialistes qualifiés qui repoussent les limites de ce qui, s possible, améliorer les gens, les vies dans le monde entier. Nous adoptons une culture d'élivitabilité dans laquelle le pouvoir et le potentiel de chaque individu peuvent être libérés.

Nous élevons des idées qui mènent à des effets positifs et à des succès continus.

Si vous voulez participer à cette mission importante, nous voulons vous entendre.

Postulez au poste de gestionnaire principal des comptes stratégiques de l'EMEA.

Responsabilités

- Établir, favoriser et gérer des relations avec des clients stratégiques importants, tels que les grands fournisseurs de réseaux et les principaux leaders d'opinion. - Coordonner les ressources internes et favoriser un environnement de collaboration pour assurer la prestation des clients, des besoins et des attentes. - Coordonner la participation de Varian, de l'équipe exécutive avec la clientèle, de l'équipe de gestion sur une base régulière et/ou au besoin.

- Constitue et dirige un plan de compte stratégique de l'entreprise, y compris des objectifs de performance mutuelle, maintient des prévisions financières précises et atteint les objectifs de vente assignés. - Conserve la propriété globale des transactions et est responsable de la modélisation, de la conception et de la progression des transactions - Représente l'ensemble du portefeuille de produits et services. Dirige un effort de développement de solutions interentreprises qui répond le mieux aux besoins des clients, lie entre le personnel client clé et le personnel Varian. - Présente régulièrement toutes les solutions Varian, aux comptes stratégiques.

- Élargit et communique régulièrement avec les équipes locales, régionales et mondiales pour assurer une approche de gestion d'équipe et une coordination harmonieuse au niveau du compte. - Maintient des scores élevés des clients en termes de promotion nette, en assurant la résolution de problèmes et en soutenant les ambitions stratégiques des clients. - En favorisant une relation mutuellement bénéfique, augmente la part du portefeuille et assure une croissance des ventes plus élevée que le marché et une rentabilité.

- Apporte des commentaires aux équipes de marketing et de produits, en tant que voix des KOLs, en raison de l'analyse, de l'évaluation et de la validation constantes des besoins des clients. - Participe à la planification financière de la Région, en contribuant avec la Région - connaissance à l'échelle du marché, nouveaux modèles commerciaux et financiers et tendances concurrentielles. - Participe à l'élaboration de plans d'encouragement des ventes de la Région, afin d'atteindre les objectifs de la Région - en cherchant à harmoniser les objectifs entre les fonctions.

- Assurer un leadership exemplaire par une communication proactive, une gestion efficace du changement et l'alignement de la stratégie au sein de l'organisation - Établir des relations de travail internes/externes productives. - Étudier les meilleures pratiques de l'industrie sur les modèles de gestion stratégique des comptes, y compris ceux qui existent déjà chez Varian et Siemens Healthineers.

Besoins

- Diplôme technique ou d'entreprise (gestion, ingénierie, etc.). - Expérience client requise, en particulier dans les rôles de vente ou de marketing. - Expérience antérieure dans la gestion de carrières complexes

jobs.title: Medical Physicist (f/m/d) - Proton Therapy
jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

Proton Therapy Solutions is seeking an experienced Medical Physicist (f/m/d) Proton Therapy to support the development and validation of advanced technologies for our customers. As part of the Product Management & Validation team, you will work closely with product management, engineering, and service teams to drive innovations that enhance our proton therapy systems. Clinical experience with a proton therapy system is required. In this role, you will act as a subject matter expert, providing guidance on testing strategies, data analysis, quality assurance, regulatory compliance, and dosimetric equipment management. Join a highly skilled and motivated team dedicated to advancing proton therapy delivery, imaging, and research. Your expertise will play a direct role in shaping cutting-edge solutions that improve patient care worldwide.

Your tasks and responsibilities:

• Maintain a thorough understanding of clinical software and hardware, including ARIA, Eclipse, proton therapy systems, quality assurance tools and software, and related analysis programs (e.g., MatLab), as well as standard dosimetric equipment

• Perform calibrations on all radiation therapy equipment and prepare comprehensive calibration reports

• Conduct radiation dosimetry characterization of new radiation treatment equipment and techniques

• Manage treatment-planning computer systems, including database maintenance and quality assurance programs

• Develop, implement, and maintain quality assurance programs in compliance with applicable regulatory agencies and safety standards

• Support the development of new products and engineering initiatives through technical consulting, education, requirements definition, and test methodology development

• Provide onsite and remote technical support, with up to 50% travel as required

Your qualifications and experience:

• Ph.D. in Physics, Medical Physics, or a closely related discipline, or M.S. in the same fields with board certification

• Completion of a clinical residency or post-doctoral training with a minimum of two years of experience performing Radiation Therapy Physics in a clinical setting is mandatory

• Certification in Therapeutic Radiological Physics by the American Board of Radiology or an equivalent certifying board

• Demonstrated competence in the theory and practice of radiation dosimetry

• Familiarity with current radiation safety standards and regulatory requirements

• Experience with proton therapy systems, preferably ProBeam or ProBeam 360

• Familiarity with product life cycle management within the medical industry

• Exposure to FLASH and FLASH research methodologies as well as working knowledge of imaging systems such as CBCT, CT, and related modalities is an advantage

• Business fluent in English, German language proficiency is an advantage

descriptionByLocale.it:
Unisciti a noi in innovazioni pionieristiche nella sanità. Per tutti. Ovunque. Sostenibile.

Il nostro ambiente stimolante e attento forma una comunità globale che celebra la diversità e l'individualità. Vi invitiamo a superare la vostra zona di comfort, offrendo risorse e flessibilità per favorire la vostra crescita professionale e personale, il tutto valutando i vostri contributi unici.

Proton Therapy Solutions sta cercando un esperto medico (m/f/d) Proton Therapy per supportare lo sviluppo e la convalida di tecnologie avanzate per i nostri clienti. Nell'ambito del team Product Management & Validation, lavorerai a stretto contatto con i team di gestione del prodotto, ingegneria e assistenza per guidare innovazioni che migliorano i nostri sistemi di terapia protone. È richiesta un'esperienza clinica con un sistema di terapia protonica. In questo ruolo, si agirà come esperto di materia tematica, fornendo indicazioni sulle strategie di test, l'analisi dei dati, la garanzia di qualità, la conformità normativa e la gestione delle apparecchiature dosimetriche. Unisciti a un team altamente qualificato e motivato dedicato ad avanzare prototerapia consegna, imaging e ricerca. La vostra esperienza svolgerà un ruolo diretto nella modellazione di soluzioni all'avanguardia che migliorano la cura dei pazienti in tutto il mondo.

I vostri compiti e responsabilità:

• Mantenere una comprensione approfondita del software e dell'hardware clinico, tra cui ARIA, Eclipse, sistemi di terapia protonica, strumenti di garanzia della qualità e software, e relativi programmi di analisi (ad esempio, MatLab), così come apparecchiature dosimetriche standard

• Eseguire le tarature su tutte le apparecchiature di radioterapia e preparare report di calibrazione completi

• Condurre la caratterizzazione della dosimetria delle radiazioni nuove apparecchiature e tecniche di trattamento delle radiazioni

• Gestire i sistemi informatici di pianificazione del trattamento, compresi i programmi di manutenzione del database e di garanzia della qualità

• Sviluppare, implementare e mantenere i programmi di garanzia della qualità in conformità alle agenzie normative vigenti e agli standard di sicurezza

• Sostenere lo sviluppo di nuovi prodotti e iniziative di ingegneria attraverso la consulenza tecnica, l'istruzione, la definizione dei requisiti e lo sviluppo della metodologia di test

• Fornire supporto tecnico in loco e remoto, con fino al 50% di viaggio come richiesto

Le tue qualifiche ed esperienza:

• Ph.D. in Fisica, Fisica Medica, o una disciplina strettamente correlata, o M.S. negli stessi campi con certificazione di bordo

• Completamento di una residenza clinica o di una formazione post-dottorale con un minimo di due anni di esperienza che eseguono la Fisica della Terapia di Radiazione in un ambiente clinico è obbligatorio

• Certificazione in Fisica Radiologica terapeutica da parte del Consiglio Americano di Radiologia o di una commissione di certificazione equivalente

• Competenza dimostrata nella teoria e nella pratica della dosimetria delle radiazioni

• Familiarità con gli attuali standard di sicurezza delle radiazioni e requisiti normativi

• Esperienza con sistemi di terapia protone, preferibilmente ProBeam o ProBeam 360

• Familiarità con la gestione del ciclo di vita del prodotto all'interno del settore medico

• L'esposizione a metodologie di ricerca FLASH e FLASH e la conoscenza di sistemi di imaging come CBCT, CT e modalità correlate è un vantaggio

• Il fluente commerciale in inglese, la conoscenza della lingua tedesca è un vantaggio

#LI-PT1
#LI-Remote

Chi siamo: Siamo un team di oltre 72.000 operatori sanitari altamente specializzati in oltre 70 paesi. Come leader nella tecnologia medica, spingiamo costantemente i confini per creare migliori risultati ed esperienze per i pazienti, non importa dove vivono o quali problemi di salute stanno affrontando. Il nostro portafoglio è cruciale per il processo decisionale clinico e le vie di trattamento.

Come lavoriamo? Quando si entra in Siemens Healthineers, si diventa uno in un team globale di scienziati, medici, sviluppatori, ricercatori, professionisti e specialisti esperti, che credono nel potenziale di ogni individuo di contribuire con idee diverse. Siamo da diversi background, culture, religioni, orientamenti politici e/o sessuali, e lavoriamo insieme, per combattere la maggior parte del mondo

Proton Therapy Solutions cherche un médecin expérimenté (h/f/d) Proton Therapy pour soutenir le développement et la validation de technologies avancées pour nos clients. Votre expertise jouera un rôle direct dans l'élaboration de solutions de pointe qui améliorent les soins aux patients dans le monde entier.

• Maintenir une compréhension approfondie des logiciels et du matériel cliniques, y compris l'ARIA, l'Eclipse, les systèmes de traitement des protons, les outils et logiciels d'assurance de la qualité et les programmes d'analyse connexes (p. ex. MatLab), ainsi que l'équipement dosimétrique standard

• Effectuer des étalonnages sur tous les équipements de radiothérapie et préparer des rapports d'étalonnage complets

• Effectuer la caractérisation de la dosimétrie des rayonnements des nouveaux équipements et techniques de traitement des radiations

• Gérer les systèmes informatiques de planification du traitement, y compris la maintenance des bases de données et les programmes d'assurance de la qualité

• Élaborer, mettre en oeuvre et maintenir des programmes d'assurance de la qualité conformes aux organismes de réglementation et aux normes de sécurité applicables

• Appuyer le développement de nouveaux produits et initiatives d'ingénierie par le biais de conseils techniques, d'éducation, de définition des exigences et d'élaboration de méthodes d'essai

• Fournir un soutien technique sur place et à distance, jusqu'à 50 % au besoin

Vos qualifications et votre expérience:

• Ph.D. en physique, en physique médicale ou dans une discipline étroitement liée, ou M.S. dans les mêmes domaines avec certification du conseil d'administration

• L'achèvement d'une résidence clinique ou d'une formation postdoctorale avec un minimum de deux ans d'expérience en radiothérapie Physique en milieu clinique est obligatoire

• Certification en physique radiologique thérapeutique par l'American Board of Radiology ou une commission de certification équivalente

• Compétence démontrée dans la théorie et la pratique de la dosimétrie des rayonnements

• Connaissance des normes actuelles de radioprotection et des exigences réglementaires

• Expérience avec les systèmes de protonothérapie, de préférence ProBeam ou ProBeam 360

• Connaissance de la gestion du cycle de vie des produits dans l'industrie médicale

• L'exposition aux méthodologies de recherche FLASH et FLASH ainsi qu'aux connaissances pratiques des systèmes d'imagerie comme le CBCT, le CT et les modalités connexes est un avantage

• Les affaires couramment en anglais, la maîtrise de l'allemand est un avantage

#LI-Remote

Notre portefeuille est crucial pour la prise de décisions cliniques et les voies de traitement.

jobs.title: Network Engineer - Cloud Operations
jobs.description:
Join us in pioneering breakthroughs in healthcare. For everyone. Everywhere. Sustainably.

Our inspiring and caring environment forms a global community that celebrates diversity and individuality. We encourage you to step beyond your comfort zone, offering resources and flexibility to foster your professional and personal growth, all while valuing your unique contributions.

Varian is seeking a Network Engineer position in support of our Managed Services global business. Our goal is to provide good operational practices and support for the operations, maintenance, and refinement of Varian’s public and private Cloud environments and services. Providing support for new and legacy applications and services hosted in the cloud, and continuous improvement of Varian’s Cloud infrastructure. The candidate will support Varian’s cloud operations to enhance, optimize, and maintain computing capabilities across our entire global cloud solution. Including collaboration with Service, Operations, Product Management and Security. The Network Engineer must have expertise with Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) & Microsoft Azure. Additional responsibilities for delivering support to the infrastructure and deployment of Varian’s applications as a Managed Service, and provide input in developing and maintaining policies, procedures, and standards. The position will receive direction from the Manager of Global Cloud Operations. Varian is seeking a Cloud Network Implementation Architect with a strong background in Palo Alto Networks to support of our Managed Services global business. You will support Varian’s cloud operations to enhance, optimize, and maintain computing capabilities across our entire global cloud solution. Including collaboration with Service, Operations, Product Management and Security. The Network Engineer must have expertise with Cloud Service Providers (CSPs) & Microsoft Azure. Additional responsibilities for delivering support to the infrastructure and deployment of Varian’s applications as a Managed Service, and provide input in developing and maintaining policies, procedures, and standards. The position will receive direction from the Manager of Global Cloud Operations. Our goal is to provide good operational practices and support for the operations, maintenance, and refinement of Varian’s public and private Cloud environments and services. Providing support for new and legacy applications and services hosted in the cloud, and continuous improvement of Varian’s Cloud infrastructure.

You are responsible for:

• Providing network operations and support for Varian’s cloud solutions. Private, public and hybrid infrastructure, network and security.

• Assisting with upgrading, installing, and configuring various cloud solutions including monitoring, application access, security, Palo Alto Networks (Highly Recommended), Citrix NetScaler, Citrix ADC

• Assisting with reporting on current infrastructure status, and planning for future usage.

• Configuring and supporting backbone connections over ExpressRoute (Azure), and direct connection and VPN architecture.

• Maintaining allocation of IP CIDR block, perform maintenance involving modification of network, subnets, vlans, routes etc.

• Verifying and action on events aggregated from network monitoring tools and Web Application Firewall using Varian approved tools.

• Troubleshooting and determining root cause of issues.

• Collaborating to quickly resolve any network related outages and resolve customer impacting issues quickly.

• Contributing to the successful execution of projects.

• Creating, updating, and completing documentation.

• Investigate root cause analysis of incidents with follow up reporting and final content generation.

• Collaborating with network engineers on procedures, techniques, tips & knowledge to improve operations, security and work performed.

• Providing the highest level of customer service.

• Advance understanding of vendor and telco/exchange/service

Des responsabilités supplémentaires pour fournir un soutien à l'infrastructure et au déploiement des applications Varian, en tant que service géré, et fournir une contribution à l'élaboration et au maintien des politiques, des procédures et des normes. Le poste sera dirigé par le gestionnaire de Global Cloud Operations.
